svg.title: Reflection from a thin film
svg.desc: Light in medium n1 strikes a thin film of thickness t and index n2 lying on medium n3. Ray 1 reflects from the top surface of the film; the rest refracts into the film, reflects from its bottom surface and comes back out as ray 2, parallel to ray 1. The two rays interfere. An animated companion below illustrates the process; its complete static alternative is shown for reduced motion and print.

g.text: Film thickness changes the reflected phase
Two-beam Fresnel approximation, λ0 = 550 nm. Propagation adds 4πnt/λ0; reflection adds a relative π
shift. Further internal reflections are omitted; thickness is schematic.
Illustrative motion • slowed down • cycle restarts
